attributes.name: url
attributes.description: GLB model URL (direct load — collapsed through the same canonical frame as a library load: author Blender-default, facing −Y, transforms applied)

attributes.name: library
attributes.description: Library type to source mesh from

attributes.name: meshName
attributes.description: Node name to instantiate from library

attributes.name: hudChaseOff
attributes.description: Hide the HUD entirely in chase view. By default chase shows the HUD **without the artificial horizon** (which would contradict the real one behind the aircraft); cockpit shows everything, in-scene

attributes.name: hudForward
attributes.description: How far ahead of the pilot's eye the HUD floats (metres)

attributes.name: maxSpeed
attributes.description: Normal top speed (m/s) — the cruise cap a released throttle settles at

attributes.name: afterburnerSpeed
attributes.description: Speed ceiling while the throttle is held past `maxSpeed`; releasing bleeds back to `maxSpeed`. ≤ `maxSpeed` disables afterburner.

attributes.name: vtolSpeed
attributes.description: Forward ground speed splitting hover (below) from plane (above). 0 = pure aeroplane, no hover regime.

attributes.name: autoGear
attributes.description: Find the model's gear-retract animations by NAME and run them from height above ground. `'off'` = manual (`setGear(up)`)

attributes.name: gearAltitude
attributes.description: Height above ground (m) at which the gear retracts; it extends again at 60% of this (hysteresis)

attributes.name: gearSound
attributes.description: Optional URL played spatially at the airframe on each gear transition

attributes.name: gearTime
attributes.description: Seconds for a full gear cycle

attributes.name: lookRange
attributes.description: How far the right stick can swing the view (degrees each way)

attributes.name: maxPitch
attributes.description: Max nose-UP attitude the stick commands (degrees)

attributes.name: lookRate
attributes.description: Look slew rate (degrees/sec at full stick)

attributes.name: lookReturn
attributes.description: How fast the view springs back to centre when released

attributes.name: chasePitchFollow
attributes.description: How much airframe PITCH the chase inherits. `0` = level pivot (plane pitches within the frame); `1` = as if parented to the airframe (a climb aims the view up)

attributes.name: chasePitchLag
attributes.description: How fast that inherited pitch catches up (per second) — the low-pass that keeps attitude jitter out of the chase

attributes.name: hoverCeiling
attributes.description: Height above ground above which the trigger is forward thrust regardless of speed (take off vertically, then fly) and the brake can't stall you below `vtolSpeed`. Below it, slowing to a hover gives the vertical trigger back for a vertical landing. 0 = off.

attributes.name: groundY
attributes.description: Assumed ground-plane height (a floor in addition to any terrain colliders)

attributes.name: submersible
attributes.description: Pass THROUGH a water surface instead of treating it as ground. Off by default — a plane hitting the sea should crash

attributes.name: crashSpeed
attributes.description: Vertical impact speed (m/s) above which a ground contact is a crash

attributes.name: lockRange
attributes.description: Max range to acquire a missile target

attributes.name: lockConeDeg
attributes.description: Half-angle of the forward cone missiles lock within

attributes.name: where
attributes.description: `always` / `underwater` / `above` — emission ramps with depth, it doesn't switch

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Capacity to ASK for (`auto` = what the preset's look needs). You may not get it — the scene divides a shared pool

attributes.name: minCount
attributes.description: Below this the effect is a lie, so it switches **off** instead. `auto` = the preset's floor (rain needs density; a few motes still read fine as motes)

attributes.name: minTier
attributes.description: Never run below this device tier, at any budget

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Higher survives longer when the pool is squeezed. Shed lowest-first

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Size of the box around the camera that particles spawn in

attributes.name: lookAhead
attributes.description: Push the spawn box along the VIEW, in units of `radius` — a camera sees a frustum, not a sphere, so a centred box births most of its particles behind you (#18)

attributes.name: lead
attributes.description: Push it along MOTION, in seconds of travel — at speed you outrun a centred box, which empties the view ahead exactly when you want it fullest (#17)

attributes.name: motes
attributes.default: Dust or plankton hanging in the light — near-weightless, slow drift. The cheapest way to make air (or water) feel like a *substance* rather than a vacuum

attributes.name: rain
attributes.default: Fast, stretched, near-vertical. Add `wind` and it slants

attributes.name: dust
attributes.default: Blown horizontally — the wind made visible

attributes.name: skin
attributes.description: Optional albedo texture URL applied to the `skin` material (reskin)

attributes.name: scale
attributes.description: Uniform scale applied to the loaded model

attributes.name: cameraTargetHeight
attributes.description: Height of the point the camera looks at

attributes.name: diskInnerRadius
attributes.description: Inner edge of accretion disk (multiple of radius)

attributes.name: diskOuterRadius
attributes.description: Outer edge of accretion disk (multiple of radius)

attributes.name: photonRing
attributes.description: Show photon ring at event horizon

attributes.name: enterable
attributes.description: Whether a biped can enter this vehicle

attributes.name: turnRate
attributes.description: Degrees per second at full speed

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Blob POOL size (fixed — they recycle, they don't grow). `coverage` decides how many are active

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: GLB whose mesh is the cloud LOBE (normalized to the blob radius, bottom-aligned). Empty = the procedural lobe

attributes.name: spread
attributes.description: Radius of the disc of cloud around you

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Blob radius — also the distance at which whiteout is total. Set at build

attributes.name: opacity
attributes.description: Blob alpha. Default OPAQUE — translucent clouds read badly. Set < 1 only for deliberate wisps

attributes.name: fogDensity
attributes.description: Whiteout density (EXP2, the scene's mode). HIGH on purpose — inside a cloud you should see nothing but white within a few metres

attributes.name: approach
attributes.description: Where the whiteout BEGINS, × `size` outside the blob. It's TOTAL well before the surface (you never see the geometry edge) and stays total until you leave

attributes.name: selfIllum
attributes.description: Self-illumination 0…1 — `1` ≈ fully self-lit (old look), `0` = only sun-lit (dark undersides)

attributes.name: coverage
attributes.description: Weather dial 0…1: wisps → overcast/thunderheads. LIVE. Gates active count + opacity + darkness + self-illum

attributes.name: castShadows
attributes.description: Opt-in: project the field's shadows onto every shadow-receiving surface ([cloud-shadows](?cloud-shadows.ts))

attributes.name: shadowStrength
attributes.description: Darkness of those shadows 0…1, scaled further by `coverage` (≈50% darkening at typical coverage)

attributes.name: seed
attributes.description: Deterministic layout — same seed, same sky

attributes.name: mapping
attributes.description: Which control scheme maps the gamepad to `ControlInput`: `'biped'`, `'car'`, or `'aircraft'`

attributes.name: drive
attributes.description: `(input: ControlInput, dt: number) => void`, called each frame with the merged input (set in code / via the creator). Named `drive`, not `onInput` — `on*` props become DOM event listeners

attributes.name: delay
attributes.description: Seconds between the bang and the panel (let the player watch it burn)

attributes.name: orbitSpeed
attributes.description: Degrees/sec — slow. This is a moment, not a ride

attributes.name: spectate
attributes.description: `orbit` circles the wreck; `chase` freezes the third-person shot you died in (static). Flat only

attributes.name: wreckage
attributes.description: Explode + leave burning wreckage (`'off'` = just the panel)

attributes.name: respawn
attributes.default: What "Respawn" does. Without it, the button isn't offered

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Fog color (hex, ignored when `syncSkybox` is true)

attributes.name: syncSkybox
attributes.description: Automatically match fog color to skybox horizon

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: Empty = the built-in code HUD (fully wired); set to a designer SVG to load one

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: HUD height as a % of the canvas's smaller dimension

attributes.name: enterDistance
attributes.description: Max distance to enter a vehicle

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Mesh or node name to make touchable. Empty = the mesh of the element this one is nested inside

attributes.name: include
attributes.description: `'subtree'` counts the named node and everything under it; `'self'` counts only the node itself

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: Max distance in world units; `0` means no limit

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Refuses hover, and drops a press already in flight

attributes.name: highlight
attributes.description: Hover outline colour; `'none'` for no highlight

attributes.name: hover
attributes.description: The pointer arrived (and is in reach)

attributes.name: unhover
attributes.description: It left, or the thing was disabled under it

attributes.name: activate
attributes.description: A press that started AND ended on it, with no veto

attributes.name: refused
attributes.description: The same press, but a veto said no

attributes.name: intensity
attributes.description: Brightness. With `modulation`, this is the MAXIMUM

attributes.name: on
attributes.description: `false` plays the DECAY region; it does not kill the light

attributes.name: geometryScale
attributes.description: Size multiplier for the default fixture

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: GLB fixture, in place of the primitive

attributes.name: shadows
attributes.description: `'on'` for a shadow generator (point / spot only)

attributes.name: b3dPointLight
attributes.description: ❌ not supported — model the blocker instead (below)

attributes.name: innerAngle
attributes.description: **spot** — inner cone in degrees; above `0` gives a true penumbra and switches to glTF falloff

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: **spot** — cone cross-section: `circle` / `square` / `none`. Projected as a gel, so an explicit `gel` wins

attributes.name: shapeAspect
attributes.description: **spot** — width/height; `2` is an ellipse or letterbox

attributes.name: shapeSoftness
attributes.description: **spot** — edge feather, as a fraction of the radius

attributes.name: gel
attributes.description: **spot** — projection texture URL (bitmap or SVG file)

attributes.name: muzzleSpeed
attributes.description: Launch speed (units/sec) along the fire direction

attributes.name: reloadRate
attributes.description: Ammo regenerated per second (0 = no reload)

attributes.name: reloadDelay
attributes.description: Seconds after firing before reload resumes

attributes.name: mass
attributes.description: Shell mass (higher flies flatter/further under drag)

attributes.name: missileSpeed
attributes.description: Cruise speed of a guided shot (`fireAt`)

attributes.name: maxLifetime
attributes.description: Seconds before an un-impacted shell self-disposes

attributes.name: turnRateDeg
attributes.description: The same agility in **deg/sec** — a computed view onto `turnRate`: set either, read either, and reading returns exactly what you set. Literal markup (`turn-rate-deg="30"`) needs computed attributes, landing in tosijs 1.8.0

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Library type for scene registry lookup

attributes.name: destroyable
attributes.description: `'on'` gives the model hit points + a death outcome

attributes.name: preset
attributes.description: A named anchor (`waist`, `left-shoulder`, `right-shoulder`, `overhead`, `wrist`). Overrides the angular fields.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Explicit `"x y z"` local position (overrides az/el/distance)

attributes.name: max-distance
attributes.description: Hide beyond this distance (m); 0 = no limit

attributes.name: useSceneGravity
attributes.description: Use scene physics gravity instead of gravityX/Y/Z

attributes.name: autoStart
attributes.description: Start emitting when scene is ready

attributes.name: attachTo
attributes.description: Mesh name to attach emitter to

attributes.name: libraryUrl
attributes.description: glb URL — mounts a library for you; use instead of `library`

attributes.name: scale
attributes.description: uniform scale applied to the instance root

attributes.name: profile
attributes.description: Detectability: `1` = seen at the platform's nominal radar range, `2` = out to 2×, `0.05` = very stealthy; **negative = always detectable** (e.g. waypoints).

attributes.name: range
attributes.description: Nominal range — a `profile 1` blip is detected within this.

attributes.name: lockTime
attributes.description: Seconds of continuous detection to acquire a lock (`0` = instant).

attributes.name: maxLocks
attributes.description: Max simultaneous locks (the nearest opposed contacts).

attributes.name: alignment
attributes.description: This radar's own faction. It locks only **opposed** blips (friendly⇄hostile); neutrals/waypoints show but never lock.

attributes.name: updateInterval
attributes.description: Radar refresh period (ms). Runs below frame-rate and is dithered across frames so many radars don't all recompute the same frame.

attributes.name: probeSize
attributes.description: Cubemap resolution per face; `auto` = device tier

attributes.name: maxDistance
attributes.description: Distance beyond which probes freeze entirely

attributes.name: farDistance
attributes.description: Distance at which the rate starts ramping toward `farRefreshRate`

attributes.name: shadowMaxZ
attributes.description: Far plane of the cascaded shadow frustum

attributes.name: shadowNormalBias
attributes.description: Offset along the surface normal — **the shadow-acne knob**. Lower it if shadows detach from small casters

attributes.name: shadowBias
attributes.description: Depth-direction bias; peter-pans sooner than `shadowNormalBias`, so tune that one first

attributes.name: shadowTextureSize
attributes.description: Shadow map resolution (per cascade); `auto` = device tier

attributes.name: activeDistance
attributes.description: Max camera-to-mesh distance a caster participates from

attributes.name: numCascades
attributes.description: Number of cascade splits (1–4); `auto` = device tier

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: Sun direction X (overridden by skybox when present)

attributes.name: intensity
attributes.description: Sun intensity (overridden by skybox when present)

attributes.name: updateIntervalMs
attributes.description: How often to re-evaluate active casters

attributes.name: azimuth
attributes.description: Sun's compass bearing as Babylon's **0–1 fraction of a full turn**, not degrees — it goes straight to `SkyMaterial.azimuth`. The one angle here that isn't degrees, because it isn't ours

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude in DEGREES (affects the sun's arc)

attributes.name: applyFog
attributes.description: Whether scene fog affects the skybox

attributes.name: prefab
attributes.description: Prefab name to spawn (usually an encounter)

attributes.name: maxAlive
attributes.description: How many groups may exist at once

attributes.name: minDistance
attributes.description: Nearest a group may appear (from the player)

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: `'player'` = a ring around the player (an encounter); `'place'` = exactly at `x`/`y`/`z` (a launchpad)

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Base height for the spawn point (the prefab places its own members)

attributes.name: facingDeg
attributes.description: Facing for a placed spawn, degrees about Y — reaches the prefab as `rotation`

attributes.name: seed
attributes.description: Deterministic placement — same seed, same battles

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Stop spawning (a boolean can't default to true — see CLAUDE.md)

attributes.name: starCount
attributes.description: Number of stars in galaxy (needed to regenerate same galaxy)

attributes.name: starIndex
attributes.description: Which star in the galaxy to render

attributes.name: scale
attributes.description: Visual scale factor for star/planet sizes

attributes.name: spectralClass
attributes.description: Spectral class: O, B, A, F, G, K, M

attributes.name: coronaSize
attributes.description: Corona thickness as fraction of radius (0=none)

attributes.name: pointLight
attributes.description: Create a point light at star center

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: SVG URL — fetched and rendered once

attributes.name: cameraRelative
attributes.description: Parent plane to active camera (HUD mode)

attributes.name: xrFrame
attributes.description: In a headset with `cameraRelative`, parent to this XR reference frame instead of the head camera. `'body'` (torso, damped yaw) keeps a panel in front of you without jittering on every head movement; leave unset for a HUD that should stay head-locked

attributes.name: pointerEvents
attributes.description: Map 3D pick hits → SVG pointer events

attributes.name: cornerRadius
attributes.description: Corner radius in WORLD units. `0` = a plain rectangle. Rounds the MESH, so corners cost triangles instead of alpha — see **Opaque panels** below

attributes.name: transparent
attributes.description: `'off'` drops the opacity texture so the plane writes depth. Pair with `cornerRadius`

attributes.name: biomeSeaLevel
attributes.description: Sea level for the biome classifier (`biome="on"`) — keep it equal to your water plane's `y`

attributes.name: biomeLapseRate
attributes.description: Height→temperature lapse. ⚠️ Must be scaled to your vertical range: `≈ baseTemperature / relief`. The 0.004 default is a small-world number and renders a 340m world entirely as snow

attributes.name: normalSmoothing
attributes.description: Low-pass the NORMALS' height field (positions stay crisp) — kills cliff-face zigzag

attributes.name: tileSize
attributes.description: World-space size of a level-0 (finest) tile

attributes.name: hiResSubdivisions
attributes.description: Vertices per tile edge (same at every level); `auto` = device tier

attributes.name: lodLevels
attributes.description: Number of LOD levels; level k tiles are `tileSize × 2^k`

attributes.name: poolSize
attributes.description: Shared tile budget; the pool renders the top-priority cells (`auto` = device tier)

attributes.name: fillBudget
attributes.description: Max tiles (re)built per frame — a churn backstop (`auto` = device tier)

attributes.name: splitFactor
attributes.description: LOD falloff: subdivide a cell when nearer than `splitFactor × tileSize`

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: Terrain radius (0 = auto from the coarsest tile)

attributes.name: grossScale
attributes.description: Gross noise frequency — a RECIPROCAL wavelength, so SMALL numbers make BIG landforms (0.015 ≈ 65m features before `horizScale`)

attributes.name: horizScale
attributes.description: Horizontal world scale — scales every tile's size AND the sampling together (>1 = bigger terrain that reaches further; a clean zoom, not just a frequency change)

attributes.name: grossAmplitude
attributes.description: Gross height multiplier. ⚠️ Meaningless on its own: it's spread over `grossScale`/`horizScale`, so the same number is a mountain range at one scale and a plain at another

attributes.name: detailAmplitude
attributes.description: Detail height multiplier. Landscape reads best when this does REAL work rather than 5% — big gross features, small gross amplitude, busy detail

attributes.name: baseHeight
attributes.description: Flat vertical offset (m). The noise is 0..amplitude; `-grossAmplitude/2` centres the terrain on 0 so a water plane at 0 floods the valleys into a sea

attributes.name: debugColor
attributes.description: Debug: tint each tile a distinct hashed colour to expose the tile/LOD layout

attributes.name: tileBuildMs
attributes.description: **Milliseconds of tile building allowed per frame** — the cap that actually bounds the worst frame. A tile COUNT bounds it only by accident (a tile's cost swings with subdivisions, octaves, device and JS engine); a time cap bounds it by construction everywhere, and self-corrects when you raise detail. Always builds ≥1 tile. (`auto` = device tier)

attributes.name: profile
attributes.description: Debug: time tile building and report it on `debugState` (see below). Off = zero cost

attributes.name: rimCollar
attributes.description: Metres the rim of a patch hole folds down into the opening

attributes.name: fieldMsPerTile
attributes.default: Noise + analytic normals. Plain float arithmetic — a worker or wasm *could* take this

attributes.name: uploadMsPerTile
attributes.default: updateVerticesData` — a GPU handoff. **Nothing** moves this off the main thread

attributes.name: nsPerSample
attributes.default: Cost per `heightAt` (each is 2 fractal calls × 6 octaves = 12 perlin evals)

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: `'camera'` or a mesh name to watch

attributes.name: muzzleSpeed
attributes.description: Shell launch speed (also the lead-solver's projectile speed)

attributes.name: smart
attributes.description: Skill curve 0..1: **lead** ramps to full by **0.5**, **drop** compensation to full by **1** (0 = aim at the target's current spot). 0.5–1 reserved for acceleration/turn-rate prediction later

attributes.name: aimTolerance
attributes.description: Fires only when the barrel is within this many degrees of the solution

attributes.name: idleColor
attributes.description: Barrel colour with no firing solution

attributes.name: armedColor
attributes.description: Barrel colour when it can bear (has a solution, in range)

attributes.name: fullRadius
attributes.description: Within this distance the blast deals full `D`

attributes.name: los
attributes.description: Line-of-sight occlusion (a wall between blast + target spares it)

attributes.name: spherical
attributes.description: Use a sphere instead of a plane

attributes.name: follow
attributes.description: Ride the camera in x/z (endless sea): the plane snaps to a coarse grid under you, ripples stay anchored in world space

attributes.name: colorBlendFactor
attributes.description: How much color tints the water

attributes.name: StarData
attributes.default: name, seed, position, spectralType, luminosity, mass, numberOfPlanets, rgb

attributes.name: widgetColor
attributes.description: Bumpers, triggers, dpad, sticks, menu, view

attributes.name: controls
attributes.description: **Comma**-separated piece list, e.g. `'a,b,right_stick(40,0),menu'`. Empty (the default) shows everything. `a/b/x/y` map to `A/B/X/Y`; `dpad` expands to the four directions; `name(dx,dy)` nudges one piece

attributes.name: idleSeconds
attributes.description: Seconds of silence before a faded pad comes back

attributes.name: fade
attributes.description: Hide the pad once a real input device is in use. `'off'` pins it visible — what you want on a page where the pad itself is the subject

attributes.name: fadedOpacity
attributes.description: How faded is faded. `0` is invisible; a low value like `0.15` leaves a hint that the fallback exists

attributes.name: brightness
attributes.default: **multiplies** the base intensity — `0` off, `1` as declared
attributes.description: "off" has to be reachable; it is the value you flicker to

attributes.name: range
attributes.description: a range of zero is a light that lights nothing

attributes.name: saturation
attributes.default: **multiplies** saturation — `0` is white, `saturationScale` sets what `1` means
attributes.description: saturation has a meaningful zero and reaching it is the point

attributes.name: hue
attributes.default: **shifts** the base hue, `0.5` = unchanged, scaled by `hueShiftDeg
attributes.description: hue is circular with no meaningful zero, so an absolute mapping would discard the colour you chose

attributes.name: cliffProfile
attributes.default: flat low shelf → sharp riser → flat top

attributes.name: beachProfile
attributes.default: wide gentle low shelf, easing rise

attributes.name: gamepad
attributes.description: When present, mount the on-screen glass gamepad wired into the input system. Bare/`true` = full layout; a value like `"a,b,left_stick"` selects controls

attributes.name: gamepadScale
attributes.description: Scale factor for the glass gamepad clusters

attributes.name: gamepadFade
attributes.description: `'off'` keeps the glass gamepad visible instead of fading it once a mouse/keyboard/hardware pad is used

attributes.name: no-xr
attributes.description: Suppress the automatic Enter-VR button (WebXR is offered by default when an immersive-vr session is supported)

attributes.name: rig
attributes.description: a piloting HUD that flies with you
